{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Step 1: Filter for loyal customers
loyal_df = df[df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Step 2: Check if revenue column is string and has thousands separators
print("Revenue column dtype:", loyal_df['revenue'].dtype)
print("First few revenue values:", loyal_df['revenue'].head().tolist())

# Step 3: Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = loyal_df[loyal_df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print("Number of QA orders in loyal group:", len(qa_orders))

# Step 4: Check for refunded orders in loyal group
refunded_loyal = loyal_df[loyal_df['status'] == 'refunded']
print("Number of refunded orders in loyal group:", len(refunded_loyal))"}
